Coastal Saint Lucie and Coastal Martin counties.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Louisiana...

Calcasieu River near White Oak Park affecting Calcasieu Parish.

For the Calcasieu River...including Glenmora, Oakdale, Oberlin,
Kinder, White Oak Park, Salt Water Barrier...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Calcasieu River near White Oak Park.

* WHEN...Until late Friday night.

* IMPACTS...At 2.0 feet, Minor flooding of Goos Ferry Road will
occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:35 PM CST Tuesday the stage was 2.1 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 10:35 PM CST Tuesday was 2.4 feet.
- Forecast...The river will oscillate around flood stage with a
maximum value of 2.4 feet early this morning.
- Flood stage is 2.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.summary:
* WHAT...This level of heat affects most individuals sensitive to
heat, especially those without effective cooling and/or adequate
hydration.

* WHERE...Puerto Rico and Virgin Islands.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 5 PM AST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...High temperatures or elevated heat indices can worsen
symptoms in people with chronic conditions. They can also increase
the risk of heat-related illness among individuals sensitive to
heat with inadequate cooling or hydration. These risks are highest
across coastal areas, lowlands, interior valleys, and urban zones.
